# Vendored QR generator

`qrcode.js` is qrcode-generator 2.0.4 by Kazuhiko Arase, distributed under the MIT license. The original copyright and license notice is retained at the top of the file.

Source: https://github.com/kazuhikoarase/qrcode-generator

Bundled locally so QR generation does not send session links to an external image service.

# Fonts

`fonts/archivo-latin.woff2` and `fonts/archivo-latin-ext.woff2` are the Archivo variable font (weight 100–900, width 62–125%) subsets served by Google Fonts (Archivo v25). Archivo is licensed under the SIL Open Font License 1.1; see `fonts/OFL.txt`. Bundled locally so the app works offline and makes no third-party font requests.
